verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official CLI that runs API collections. It is documented for CI/CD pipelines, including Docker images and GitHub Actions, and it emits JUnit reports for collections that carry assertions and test suites, which is the standard way CI surfaces test regressions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-zero exit codes or build-failure behavior on failed assertions, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my API test collections in CI with a CLI and fail the build on regressions

citations.quote: With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.
CI/CD Integration: Effortlessly integrate with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and validation.
Easily create reports in multiple formats, including JSON, JUnit, and HTML, to analyze and share test results.
Run your collections in Docker, GitHub Actions, and other pipelines.
Official Docker images for the Bruno CLI let you run API collections in CI/CD pipelines and locally without installing Node.js or npm on the host.
Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing.
